text:
ade: incoming ticket from Mosaic Therapeutics — Jan invoice duplicated and one copy missing embeddings lines. Ticket #BILL-8387.
billing-bot: daily_reconcile job finished 2025-02-22T07:00:00Z. Alert: duplicate_invoice_group for customer_id=MT-401 period=2025-01.
karen: invoice ids?
ade: INV-2025-7721 and INV-2025-7721-aux. Totals differ by $0.22 and embedding_line_items absent on INV-2025-7721 (first).
devon: quick log check: invoice-generator attempted a line_items flush then hit a transient DB write timeout and retried without idempotency key. snippet: ```
2025-02-01T00:00:01Z WARN invoice_gen: flush_line_items timeout after 12s
2025-02-01T00:00:01Z INFO invoice_gen: retrying create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-02-01T00:00:01Z INFO invoice_gen: new invoice INV-2025-7721-aux created (no line_items)
```
karen: customer asks for corrected invoice and refund for duplicate. Recommend manual void + credit while eng patches generator.
finance-manager: authorize remediation: void duplicate invoice and issue credit. cap refund <= $7k. Please update ticket and notify CS.
ade: running ad-hoc tool: `./ops/invoice_tools.py --void INV-2025-7721-aux --credit --note "duplicate retry"`
ade: done — credit CR-4210 issued for $3,412.88, INV-2025-7721-aux voided, customer emailed. Ticket updated #BILL-8387.
devon: plan: add fallback idempotency using sha256(customer_id + period + usage_checksum) when request_id missing; make invoice + line_items atomic in DB transaction; add integration test simulating line_items timeout. I'll open PR and aim for hotfix today.
karen: add runbook item: before manual void, search for invoices for same customer+period created within 3 minutes, check line_items presence, then run void/credit. Also add alert rule for duplicates within time window.
finance-manager: confirm customer refunded and notified. Schedule a reconciliation run after hotfix. Filing postmortem PID-BILL-8387.
ade: closing loop — ticket updated, refund processed, eng follow-up in PR. :white_check_mark:
